Subject: Greenlane QBR prep and forecast update

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for partnering with us this quarter. We're pulling materials for next week's QBR with your team and wanted to share an updated topline forecast and two account-level notes: one for the pilot expansion (EdgeOps) and one for the renewal (CoreSearch). See attached "Greenlane_RSF_v2.pdf" for the details.

High level ask: can Redwood confirm the committed capacity and any known latency variances for CoreSearch by Friday so procurement can finalize the renewal wording? Also we need an account-by-account one-pager from you with top risks and recommended mitigations (approx. 150-200 words each) for EdgeOps and CoreSearch.

Tentative meeting: Wed, 30 Jun at 11:00 PT — is that still good for your side? I'll add Procurement on the thread once the final numbers are in.

Attachments: Greenlane_RSF_v2.pdf (research + forecast), draft_vendor_questions.docx (referenced)

Thanks,
Sarah
Director, Cloud Platform Programs
Greenlane Inc.

- Account one-pagers x2 (Marissa + Sean review) — 150-200 words, impact, risk, recommended mitigation
- SLA/latency note (Rishi) — callouts re: 95th/99th pct and recent kernel patch
- Attendance + slide owner list (Laura)

I'll compile into a single packet and share the Drive link. If anyone needs extra cycles, call with me Tues morning.

Sean Gallagher

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlane QBR prep and forecast update — consolidated draft attached

Team — draft consolidated forecast attached (QBR_ACCOUNTS_matrix.xlsx). Key notes in the sheet:
- Pilot (EdgeOps): $420k next 12mo upside; dependency: completion of model-parity eval (targeted 07/12)
- Renewal (CoreSearch): base renewal $1.1M; Procurement asked for a 99.9% latency SLO which we do not currently advertise — I flagged in the "ContractRisks" tab
- Committed capacity: 4x A100-equivalent reserved for CoreSearch across two regions (us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 DR)

Draft one-pagers below (summaries) — please review and edit inline in Drive: 
- EdgeOps: Redwood recommendation is a staged expansion with a canary for the quantized variant; mitigation: prefix caching and request-level fallback to the larger vm in peak windows.
- CoreSearch: Primary risk is tail latency for large-context reranks; mitigation: gated batching + KV cache pin for hot prefixes; consider short-term dedicated capacity for billing window.

Attachments: QBR_ACCOUNTS_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Marissa
Senior Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlane QBR prep and forecast update — technical risk addendum

Quick technical note to drop into the packet:
- 95th/99th latency baseline (last 30 days): CoreSearch: 95p=48ms, 99p=226ms on our hosted infra; when running on quantized variant in internal perf runs we saw 99p increase by ~40–60ms for long-context (>4k tokens) rerank calls.
- Root cause: for certain attention patterns the quantized kernel falls back to non-optimized paths; we've got a kernel patch post-07/05 that reduces fallback rates by ~70% in staging.
- Recommendation for the renewal: avoid hard 99.9% latency SLO on the quantized path; propose SLA addendum: 99p guaranteed on standard profile, best-effort on quantized with scheduled remediation milestone (target: patch rollout 07/05).

Also adding two quick risk labels for the account one-pagers: OPERATIONAL_LATENCY, ROLLOUT_DEPENDENCY. I'll add a short troubleshooting playbook entry for the runbook.

Rishi
Principal Reliability Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

- CoreSearch (renewal): base renewal $1.1M; committed reserved capacity: 4 A100-eq; recommended SLA language: 99p for standard profile, quantized path listed as best-effort with patch milestone 07/05.
- EdgeOps (pilot expansion): opportunity $420k ARR; recommended phased rollout with canary and prefix caching enabled.
- Action items for QBR: procurement confirms wording by Fri 02 Jul; Redwood will provide post-demo performance logs within 48h of QBR.

Meeting confirmed: Wed, 30 Jun 11:00 PT — Zoom link in Drive packet. If you want a 15-minute prebrief (internal) Tues 08:30 PT, say so and I'll set it.

Thanks all — nice cross-functional work here.

Sean Gallagher
